objective: Estimate absolute correct-structure product amount and minor-isomer amount in a specified C-N reaction matrix despite coelution and identical molecular mass.

available_source_evidence.authentic_standard_preparation: Source reports separate regioselective precursors, isolation on silica and NMR for 3,6,13,14.
available_source_evidence.calibration: Source reports five pure-compound/caffeine levels on Nile and Ganges; exact per-wavelength calibration files have not been acquired.
available_source_evidence.raw_data: Source reports deposited Waters RAW/mzML on Globus; no authenticated acquisition here.
available_source_evidence.binary_blind_mixture_truth: NOT FOUND in acquired SI/code/ORD; not inferred from reaction scatter plots.
available_source_evidence.assay_unit_contract: UNRESOLVED: ORD caffeine0.0067M detail versus0.0667M workup; SI calibration units/additional aliquot; code max_yield normalization. Resolve against raw calibration recipes and exact run arguments before test.

required_standard_records: Structure identity with precursor, purification, 1H/13C/19F NMR as relevant, structural assignment and raw NMR FIDs; HRMS alone cannot distinguish these regioisomers.
Unique standard lot and synthesis batch, independent assay of purity, residual solvent/water, balance mass, uncertainty, solvent volume or gravimetric dilution, timestamp and storage history.

Separate calibration-stock and validation-stock preparations. Prefer independently prepared or independently assayed material; reusing one incorrectly quantified stock in calibration and truth cannot test absolute accuracy.
Certified quantitative internal-standard identity, purity, mass, amount and uncertainty. Caffeine addition amount and all dilution volumes must reconcile to the theoretical-product denominator.
required_blind_mixture_records: Random sample ID; intended preparation ratio; independently measured amount of each isomer; reference uncertainty; preparation batch/day; preparer; matrix lot; blinded key released only after predictions frozen.

Reference by validated quantitative19F NMR for 3/13 if sample amount permits: measured T1, adequate relaxation delay, linearity, nonoverlapping assignments demonstrated by authentic co-spikes, integration procedure and raw FID.
Alternative reference by independently resolving LC only after authentic co-injections demonstrate separation and response calibration. Do not assume changing2min to8min resolves3/13.

Reference measurements before final analytical dilution, with independently recorded dilution uncertainty; at least selected final samples independently rechecked for recovery. Source-derived deconvolution labels are excluded from ground truth.

Pure3 and pure13 controls, mixtures including minor5% fractions in both directions, balanced mixture, matrix blanks and carryover blanks. Test concentrations above and below the source20% combined-yield region.
required_target_observations: Original Waters RAW directory and conversion output mzML with SHA256 manifest, conversion version/options and units; do not use screenshot digitization as spectra.
Time-by-wavelength PDA arrays covering product and full caffeine peaks, unsmoothed and processed data, acquired wavelength grid/resolution, sampling rate, detector ranges/saturation flags.
Positive/negative QDa traces and m/z windows with adduct assignment; mass channel supports molecular formula/retention checks, not regioisomer identity by itself.
Instrument serial and name, column and guard lot/age, method-file hash, gradients, temperature, flow, injection volume/mode, software version, acquisition timestamp and injection order.

Reaction plate ID/well, analytical subplate ID/well, exact split mapping, independent stock/batch IDs, additions and timestamps, reaction temperature/time, quench and dilution, evaporation/precipitation observations, transfer recovery and raw limiting-reactant amount.
Preserve all failed acquisitions, missing observations, saturated/negative/low-signal cases and detection limits; no replacing UNKNOWN with zero.
drift_and_background_contract: Pure-standard calibration scans bracket the actual sample run on the same instrument. Estimate or bound wavelength-dependent transfer, peak-shape change and run-order drift.

Full caffeine spectrum can test relative wavelength gain if independently stable and uncontaminated. Establish gain comparability between caffeine and product retention times;270nm scalar alone cannot do this.
Solvent blank, quenched reagent/ligand/catalyst matrix blank, pure-product spikes into those matrices and standard additions to selected real crude samples.
Record covariance across wavelengths and shared normalization noise; include calibration-stock and dilution uncertainty. Do not count wavelength channels as independent experimental repeats.

An unbounded coeluting species with spectrum in the product-basis span defeats residual-only concentration guarantees. Either restrict the target matrix with measured controls, bound interferents, or obtain an orthogonal reference on each disputed actual sample.

minimal_falsification_pilot.same_actual_disputed_sample_orthogonal_r: Required to adjudicate a disputed actual-reaction yield. Pilot mixtures alone cannot exclude a sample-specific in-span interferent.
minimal_falsification_pilot.outcome_scope: Can falsify gross matrix bias, false-isomer calls or incorrect normalization. Passing establishes only this pilot's tested scope.

matrices: one specified quenched target-recipe blank matrix
planned_benchmark_design.qualification: Planned counts, not acquired data or a power guarantee. Two batches and one target matrix do not establish universal reaction-matrix reliability. Expand only after pilot survival and a prespecified precision/power calculation.

matched_comparison.incumbent: Source authentic-standard-informed multivariate regression, with sensible nonnegative/weighted or generalized least-squares variant where declared; calibrated resolved LC/qNMR when available.
matched_comparison.candidate: Frozen proposed operation; source labels cannot be used as held-out truth.
primary_metrics: false minor-isomer calls on pure samples

cost_and_access_ledger.status: UNKNOWN until actual acquisition; no practical advantage or full-cost comparison asserted.

promotion_gate: Actual independently referenced measurements, frozen matched comparisons, uncertainty/error specification and end-to-end access/preparation/measurement/computational costs. Existing SI graphs alone cannot pass this gate.
